people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t believe it.
translations.bsb: At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There He is!’ do not believe it.
translations.kjv: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:
